findings.title: IDOR: order lookup missing ownership check
findings.description: GET /orders/:id returns any order without verifying the caller owns it. getOrder(id, _uid) discards the authenticated user id after the authn gate.

findings.title: Smoke tests omit cross-user denial
findings.description: Happy-path smoke covers health and owned list/create flows but does not assert that alice cannot read bob's order by id.

findings.title: Principal is a forgeable header
findings.description: X-User-Id is accepted as identity with no signature or session binding. Acceptable for a mini-app, but architecture note for production.
